publish.title: Why phone batteries age (and what helps)
publish.description: Lithium-ion wear in plain words: what speeds it up and what slows it down.

scenes.headline: Why phone batteries age
scenes.narration: Your phone battery holds less than it used to. That is not a defect. Here is why it happens.

scenes.headline: Every charge costs a little
scenes.narration: A phone battery is lithium-ion. Each time it charges and discharges, the cells lose a little of their capacity.

scenes.headline: What wears it faster
scenes.narration: Heat is the main enemy. Letting a battery swing all the way from empty to full, or sitting full while hot, also adds stress.

scenes.headline: What helps
scenes.narration: Keep it cool, top up in smaller steps, and avoid ultra-fast charging when you can.
items: Avoid ultra-fast charging when you can

scenes.headline: Do not obsess
scenes.narration: Modern phones manage charging for you. Staying cool and sensible beats clever rules.

scenes.headline: Keep it out of the heat
scenes.narration: If you remember one thing, keep your phone out of hot cars and direct sun.
